verdict.summary:
> 🤖 SPARQ agent

The change correctly removes the duplicated `gh` token from all three watchdog read builders and adds a single shared fail-loud guard at the retry layer. The guard runs before subprocess execution, while the shell read entry point reports a precise usage refusal. The tests are non-vacuous: they exercise the real production read seam beneath `gh_retry`, assert the exact executed argv, validate distinct endpoints and parsed results, verify downstream census delivery, and pair the static reader scan with a positive write-path control. The write seam remains unchanged, and no trust check, permission boundary, token handling, or retry-scope rule is weakened.
